stage: pre-implementation; no v2 fit or holdout run yet
training_simulation: unchanged kit; default sensor realization; no config seed/offset/drift read by runtime
train_targets: only v1 estimator last_wrench[:2], computed from allowed measured inputs; no plant/log/oracle data

C_normal.hypothesis: bounded normal-only outer admittance improves sustained pre-release support
references: Lie Group Robot Control lecture2024 sections11.1,11.4,11.5
C_normal.geometry: constant taught-endpoint full 6D world bottom-centre Jacobian; translation z only, first-order tangent/rotation unchanged; joint displacement/velocity/acceleration mutually consistent
C_normal.antiwindup: clip scalar displacement and velocity; freeze further downward integration on alarm; return boundedly after release
C_normal.selection: per architecture on four nonofficial no-collision validation episodes: >=3/4 G4 pass, support improvement >=.25mg, peak<=1.1mg all, TCPmax<=1.05*v1, steps<=1.05*v1, saturation0/divergence0/false0; otherwise reject without retuning

L_residual.hypothesis: learn normal wrench baseline and use symmetric horizontal EMA to improve weak-force detection
L_residual.features: 77 numeric basis: 1,sin(qref),cos(qref),qdref,qddref,qdref*abs(qdref),mass/8,COM/.05,mass*qdref,mass*qddref,mass*sin(qref),COM outer sin(qref),reference jerk; no case/time index or lookup
L_residual.normalization: per-architecture train-only mean/std; floor1e-6; standardized runtime clip[-8,8]
L_residual.score: EMA alpha.1 of Euclidean norm of horizontal prediction error; 4-cycle persistence,8-cycle release
L_residual.gate: only recognized shared-estimator controller, grip and outside table-height band; v1 channels always retained OR
L_residual.threshold: max(3 N,1.20*maximum score across disjoint no-collision validation+0.5 N); one freeze before any development collision, never refit after collisions
L_residual.selection: validation no extra false alarm; balanced-development total >=4 extra detected across A/B without increased false rises, no lost v1 detections and p99 combined<800us; otherwise reject; no threshold/gain changes after development

geometry_audit.hypothesis: frame/power audit prevents coordinate artifacts but does not create source observability
geometry_audit.tests: coadjoint power invariance, force/moment origin shift, Jacobian virtual power, equal vertical wrench counterexample; nonlinear-vs-linear normal shift finite-error check
geometry_audit.other_candidates: NRIC/DOB/P-APD/P-IDC excluded high-gain elasticity risk and observer collision-rejection confound; mass/COM RLS unnecessary because supplied exact, load/contact confounded; pRNE actual chapter8.3 absent in scan; full SE3 log/dexp and seventh-order entire-cycle replacement excluded as larger change than mm-scale target, not claimed impossible

G4.applies_to: positive masses, specifically final 8kg A/B; failure remains failure

development.design: 32 collision episodes per architecture stratified cyclic over masses; matched no-collision references; no collision training/thresholding

holdout.design: four no-collision references,30 stratified force/time/direction collisions plus4 offsets per architecture/version; do not generate/run/read results before source+weights freeze; no post-holdout tuning

robustness: exact d4_robustness.build_cases 385/architecture for fresh v1 and final v2; analysis-only legacy perturbation matrix 25/architecture/version plus new noise seeds; no sim module monkeypatch
ablation: baseline/v1/C-only/L-only/C+L; final baseline/new controller x baseline/new detector 8 official combinations; rejected methods kept only as experiments
runtime: numpy+mujoco+public sim only,self-contained final entries; embedded weights; no torch,pickle,ONNX; separate train venv only
timing: paired compute+update wall and thread CPU,median,p99,max,all >=1ms outliers plus process-load/rusage; G5 strict max<1ms separate from p99 selection gate; never claim hard real-time
